title: Iraq Museum, Taq Kasra & Dur-Kurigalzu
full_text:
Visit the Iraq Museum and explore its national treasures.
Visit Taq Kasra, the last remains of the city Ctesiphon.
Head to the Ziggurat of Dur-Kurigallzu, the tallest ziggurat in Iraq standing at a height of 52 meters.
Visit the shrines of Kadhimiya at night.
